reason: I only have Saturdays, and I'd take the free first visit but I probably wouldn't pay after that. Storytime at the library is free and I'm still chasing my kid, so I never really get to sit and drink the coffee.
objection: On Saturdays I'm paying $14 for a toddler who wants me playing with him anyway, and the coffee isn't worth much to me. Weekends only means maybe 2 visits a month, so a $45 membership doesn't make sense.
would_change_my_mind: Weekend hours that are reliably open, and a drop-in closer to $10 or a pack price that makes a Saturday visit feel cheap.
